scope: Extend the generated AC1027 OBJECTS transaction graph with multiple PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX entries and verify their remapped entity targets.

source.profile: One PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX with three extent entries targeting one emitted LINE, POINT, and classic POLYLINE; the graph also contains FIELD/FIELDLIST, MOTIONPATH/CURVEPATH/POINTPATH, OBJECTPTR, and a compound POLYLINE with two VERTEX children.

implementation.method: Extend the existing all-offset OBJECTS allocation sweep; require unchanged three-entry index and caller graph plus destination preservation at every failure, then same-codec exact-byte retry and fresh typed readback of each emitted target handle and extent.

validation.verboseCTest: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -V -R '^libdxfrw_partial_viewing_index_objects_allocation_retry$': PASS; 52 ASCII and 51 Binary offsets reported with rollback/retry/readback PASS

limitations: Generated transaction and graph-closure evidence only; producer interoperability and native viewing semantics are not qualified.
Only one three-entry profile and the selected three entity target types are covered; larger index vectors and other target families remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: The generated three-entry PVI preserves its variable-length caller state and resolves all three targets through failure, same-codec retry, and typed readback in both encodings.
